name: evol-maze-maker
description: Generate square, circular, triangular, hexagonal, star and heart-shaped mazes with seven algorithms (backtracker, Prim, Kruskal, Wilson, hunt-and-kill, growing tree, Aldous-Broder), pick a short or long solution, solve them with the keyboard or a finger or reveal the answer, and export them as SVG or PNG or print them. Works offline, no dependencies.
author: Olivier Giulieri (https://evoluteur.github.io/)
